card.name: First digit of two-digit numbers in tables
card.fires_on: The first digit of a two-digit number split across tokens, mostly in dose tables, age ranges and numbered lists. It also fires on a few spots partway through drug names such as pramipexole and phenylbutyrate.

modes.label: Leading digit in tables
modes.description: The first digit of a two-digit number in age bands or stepped dose tables, with the second digit following.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: A syllable partway through a long drug name that is repeated in the text.

card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a two-digit number in dose or age tables, and sometimes partway through a long drug name.
